title: RulesDef (godot/content/defs/rules.json)
$comment: R0 B.1: world constants only; everything else lives in 02's files. Canonical: gravity 6.0, ceilings 1500/2000, tick_hz 30, lift_model speed_scaled, path_expansions_per_tick 120 (R0 B.11 A-55; was 2000), sim_budget_profile [1, 2], friendly_fire/debug_commands/profile_enabled false. R0 B.11 A-51 appends the sim constants that were named consts: command_rate_per_s, command_burst (04 s11.3), uplink_margin_m (05 C6), request_ttl_s (05 C10/C17), override_echo_s (05 s3.4), shooter_grace_ticks (03 s6.1), path_heuristic_pct (03 s3.6), cut_ladder (03 s4.3 rungs as data).

path_expansions_per_tick.$comment: 03 s3.6 / R0 B.11 A-55: 120 calibrated by S-NAV-1 (TA-20 REPORT s5: ~15 us per expansion in-tick); 01 s7 anchor 2,000 superseded by data; sanity bounds

items.$comment: 03 s4.3 cut ladder rungs 1-8 (rung 8 appended by R0 B.11 A-55)

command_rate_per_s.$comment: 04 s11.3 token bucket: 10 commands/s sustained (sim S10, R0 C2-27); CommandValidator.RATE_PER_S until TA-49

uplink_margin_m.$comment: 05 C6 / C6r: POSSESS refused at altitude >= ceiling_hard_m - uplink_margin_m (= 1,950 m; REJECTED_UPLINK); ControlMachine.UPLINK_MARGIN_M until TA-49

request_ttl_s.$comment: 05 s2 request_tick / C10 / C17: a hand-over request expires after 10 s (ControlMachine.REQUEST_TTL_S until TA-49)

override_echo_s.$comment: 05 s3.4 / C2: ORDER_FAILED(OVERRIDDEN) echo when the previous human head is younger than 10 s (ControlMachine.ECHO_WINDOW_S until TA-49)

shooter_grace_ticks.$comment: 03 s6.1 step 8: a projectile skips its shooter for 10 ticks after its first collision tick (Collision.shooter_grace_ticks, set by SimWorld until TA-49)

path_heuristic_pct.$comment: 03 s3.6 / TA-20 REPORT s3: A* heuristic inflation in percent; 25 measured (0 = exact A*); Pathing.set_heuristic_pct until TA-49

ground_turn_rate_dps.$comment: TA-38 / 03 s5.3: ground unit heading rate at full yaw stick, degrees per second (tuning value)

ground_reverse_speed_mps.$comment: R0 C2-09: a ground unit reverses at this speed (3 m/s) once BRAKE has been held ground_reverse_hold_s

ground_reverse_hold_s.$comment: R0 C2-09: BRAKE held this long (0.5 s) turns stop into reverse

ground_slope_speed_loss.$comment: 02 s3 / R0 C2-11: ground speed x (1 - loss x slope_deg / max_slope_deg); 0.6 canonical

cut_ladder.$comment: 03 s4.3 cut ladder as data (R0 B.11 A-51, A-55): the value each rung applies when listed in sim_budget_profile or activated by set_budget_profile. Rung 7 (native twins) is code and has no field.

rung_3_projectile_cap.$comment: live projectile cap 2,000 -> 1,400 (weapons refuse to fire when full, towers first)

rung_4_ship_pairs_tier_a_only.$comment: ship-ship collision only within tier A sets + towers

rung_5_tier_b_hz.$comment: tier B snapshot rate 15 -> 10 Hz (04 s4.1; net reads it)

rung_6_unit_cap.$comment: unit cap 80 -> 60 per player (overrides match_rules.caps.<profile>.units while active)

rung_8_path_expansions_per_tick.$comment: path_expansions_per_tick 120 -> 60 (TA-20 REPORT s5 rung 3: 3b p95 halves, 15 km worst ~74 ticks)

id.$comment: lowercase snake_case, loads as StringName (R0 B)

presentation.$comment: 07-owned; stripped from the content hash (03 s9.2). Keys: R0 B.1 ship block + 03 s15.3 PresentationDef + 02 s7 icon.
